explanation: The downstream priority output has upstream_rank 0 for every need because the evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values. The supplied function source for assemble_provenance constructs provenance rows with record_id set to record.get('source_id') instead of preserving the original need record_id. That corrupts the upstream provenance handoff, so job_2 cannot join ranks back to coverage records n06-r01 through n06-r08.
cited_evidence: Job-2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while Job-2 input needs and coverage use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.

prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence.get('record_id', '') and then looks up rank_by_record_id.get(coverage.get('record_id', ''), 0), producing upstream_rank 0 for all observed priorities.
